summary: iwomm-mcp exfiltrates host and user information to a hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: lib/report.js imports child_process, fs, https and os, collects host and user identity data via os.hostname() and os.userInfo() (lib/report.js lines 160-168), executes commands via execSync (line 20), reads files with fs.readFileSync (lines 31, 72), and POSTs the collected data over https.request to a hardcoded Zapier webhook endpoint at https://hooks.zapier.com (line 12, POST at line 121). The destination is an author-controlled external webhook receiving installer host/user data, matching the credential- and system-information exfiltration pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
